meta.census: Census 2021 (21 March 2021), ONS via Nomis, OGL v3.0. Tenure is TS054 (households). Age is TS007A, grouped from five-year bands.
meta.councilTax: Valuation Office Agency, Council Tax stock of properties (CTSOP1.1) at 31 March 2026, OGL v3.0. Counts are rounded to the nearest 10; some small band counts are suppressed in the source.
meta.note: Shown as background about who lives and pays council tax in the neighbourhood, not as a judgement or a safety score. Census figures are from 2021 and will have changed. Council tax bands in England are based on 1991 values.
